title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-12 Noether RA26 Paper 02 symbol audit tranche
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This version keeps the curated reader-facing working surface and adds a compact RA26 source-critical symbol-audit package rather than raw audit sprawl.

Current reader files. The main cumulative readers and standalone English paper PDFs remain the reader-facing surface. The RA26 package is a correction/audit tranche for the German/source branch of Paper 02, not a full multilingual propagation package.

Status at a glance. This is not a certified critical edition. The files are useful working drafts and translation drafts; subtle formula errors, scan-reading errors, apparatus drift, and cross-language synchronization errors may remain. Verify important equations, tables, theorem statements, and unusual notation against the source witnesses before citation-critical use.

Latest correction package. RA26 is a source-critical mathematical symbol audit for Noether Paper 02 printed pp.76-80 top. It closes the current German/source branch through printed p.79 and p.80 top before §23, treating display layout, vertical rules, stars, braces, row grouping, and spatial arrays as source-confirmed mathematical content rather than TeX convenience. The next target is Paper 02 p.80 §23 onward; table plates remain open.

Known open items. RA12-RA26 German corrections remain queued for EN/ES/JA/FR/ZH after local Paper 02 closure. Full symbol-level source audit remains open beyond Paper 01 and the current Paper 02 tranche.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Latest public update adds N_SYM_RA26_P02_p76_80_20260612.zip. RA26 is German/source-branch only: Paper 02 is closed through printed p.79 and p.80 top before §23; p.80 §23 onward and table plates remain open; EN/ES/JA/FR/ZH propagation remains queued. Not a certified critical edition.
